posts.text:
Sad to hear about the terror attack in Germany. RIP to the woman who died and I hope the injured make a recovery.

As usual, it sounds like it was 100% preventable and they had multiple chances to stop it before it happened. Yet they chose not to.
posts.summary: Criticizes preventable terror attack, blames authorities for inaction

posts.text:
People have been pretending that men can be women (and vice versa) for about a decade now... 

While it was fun breaking women's powerlifting records, I do wonder how many collective years and brain cells have been wasted on this completely manufactured 'social issue'.
